findings.title: parseBody ignores cached formData and re-serializes body after c.req.formData()
findings.suggested_fix: In parseFormData, reuse an existing cache before reading the body: `if (request instanceof HonoRequest && request.bodyCache.formData) { formData = await request.bodyCache.formData } else { ...arrayBuffer + bufferToFormData + cache... }`. Add a regression test in src/request.test.ts or src/utils/body.test.ts that calls `await req.formData()` and then `await req.parseBody()` for both multipart and urlencoded bodies.
findings.first_evidence: src/utils/body.ts:126 -- const arrayBuffer = await (request as Request).arrayBuffer()

residual_risks: Rejected formData promise is now cached in bodyCache.formData by parseFormData before it resolves, so a later c.req.formData() returns the same rejection (same as before, since raw.formData() also failed); not judged a regression.
testing_gaps: No test covers c.req.formData() (or a prior parseBody) followed by parseBody() on the same HonoRequest, the path that regressed.

findings.title: parseFormData rework and formData cache have no ordering/reuse tests
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests in src/request.test.ts (req.parseBody()) and src/utils/body.test.ts: (1) HonoRequest with multipart and urlencoded bodies, `await req.formData()` then `await req.parseBody()`, asserting the parsed values; (2) `parseBody` called twice on one HonoRequest; (3) parseBody then `req.formData()` returns the cached instance. Then fix parseFormData to reuse `request.bodyCache.formData` when it is already set, mirroring the guard in src/validator/validator.ts lines 115-116, before calling arrayBuffer().
findings.first_evidence: src/utils/body.ts:126 -- const arrayBuffer = await (request as Request).arrayBuffer()

residual_risks: Content-Type edge shapes for the new media-type extraction are untested: leading/trailing whitespace before ';' (the `.trim()` in parseBody) and a missing or empty Content-Type header reaching parseFormData with `|| ''`.

The validator json path has a mixed-case test only for a bare 'Application/JSON'. The regex /i flag also newly accepts mixed-case suffix types such as 'Application/Vnd.API+JSON' and mixed-case parameter names, which have no tests.
testing_gaps: No negative test that a mixed-case non-form media type (for example 'Text/Plain' or 'Application/Json' on parseBody) still returns {} from parseBody.

findings.title: parseBody re-parses re-serialized body after cached formData, yielding garbage or 500
findings.suggested_fix: In parseFormData, when request is a HonoRequest and request.bodyCache.formData is already set, await and use it instead of calling arrayBuffer()/bufferToFormData; only build and cache the promise when no formData is cached. Add a test that calls c.req.formData() before c.req.parseBody() for both multipart and urlencoded bodies.
findings.first_evidence: src/utils/body.ts:126 -- const arrayBuffer = await (request as Request).arrayBuffer()

residual_risks: Hono-internal validation and parseBody now accept mixed-case media types; any upstream component (WAF, proxy) that keys on case-sensitive Content-Type to inspect bodies could disagree with Hono's parsing. Outside this repo, not verifiable here.
testing_gaps: No test covers c.req.formData() followed by parseBody() on the same HonoRequest (cache interaction introduced by the arrayBuffer-based parseFormData).

findings.title: parseBody after c.req.formData() now throws 500 (behavior regression)
findings.suggested_fix: In parseFormData, when `request instanceof HonoRequest && request.bodyCache.formData` is already set, `await` that cached promise/value and skip arrayBuffer()/bufferToFormData; only otherwise read arrayBuffer, call bufferToFormData, and populate the cache. Add a regression test calling c.req.formData() then c.req.parseBody() (and the reverse) with a multipart body.
findings.first_evidence: src/utils/body.ts:126 -- const arrayBuffer = await (request as Request).arrayBuffer()

residual_risks: parseBody matching changed from prefix (startsWith) to exact media-type equality; a nonstandard type such as 'multipart/form-data-foo' that previously reached the form parser now returns {}. Very unlikely to matter in practice.

After parseBody on a HonoRequest, bodyCache key order changes (arrayBuffer now precedes formData), which affects the first-key selection in cloneRawRequest; checked and it still works because req.arrayBuffer() resolves, but not covered by a test.
testing_gaps: No test covers calling c.req.formData() before c.req.parseBody() on the same HonoRequest with a multipart body; the new body.test.ts cases only use plain Request objects or parseBody first.

findings.title: Composition: formData() then parseBody() re-serializes body, boundary mismatch throws
findings.suggested_fix: In parseFormData, when `request instanceof HonoRequest`, short-circuit on the cache: `const formData = request.bodyCache.formData ? await request.bodyCache.formData : await (async () => { ...arrayBuffer + bufferToFormData + cache... })()`. Alternatively call `request.formData()` for HonoRequest (as before) and use the arrayBuffer/bufferToFormData path only for raw Request objects, so case-insensitive handling lives in bufferToFormData. Add a regression test: `await c.req.formData(); await c.req.parseBody()` on a multipart request. Assumption: the new arrayBuffer path exists so bufferToFormData can normalize the media type case.
findings.first_evidence: src/utils/body.ts:126 -- const arrayBuffer = await (request as Request).arrayBuffer()

residual_risks: parseFormData now overwrites `bodyCache.formData` with a new promise on every parseBody call, even when one is already cached (for example after the validator('form') middleware). This is harmless for content, but object identity of the cached FormData changes between calls.

The validator regexes and parseBody's `split(';')[0].trim()` accept different Content-Type shapes (for example `multipart/form-data ; boundary=x` with whitespace before `;`). parseBody accepts it while validator('form') skips it. This was pre-existing in spirit and only mildly widened by this diff.
testing_gaps: No test covers calling `c.req.formData()` (or the validator('form') middleware, then formData) before `c.req.parseBody()` on the same HonoRequest. The parseBody tests build raw Request objects, and the old HonoRequest-cache interaction is not exercised at the HonoRequest level.
